scoring_justification: The young modulus values are the final output of a full MD simulation that cannot be recomputed by the verifier; we compare the agent's reported moduli to the paper's reported values with tolerance and trend check.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected Young's modulus values for Model-1 and Model-2 at temperatures 25–200 K from Table III of the paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from the paper's table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values for the same computed quantity; they serve as the ground truth for comparison.

outputs.description: LAMMPS data file for Model-1 initial structure.
LAMMPS data file for Model-2 initial structure.

schema.description: Each row: model name, temperature in Kelvin, Young's modulus in GPa. Rows: 16 (8 temperatures for Model-1 then 8 for Model-2). No extra columns allowed. Model-1 rows must appear before any Model-2 rows, and temperature values must be strictly ascending within each model.

outputs.description: Computed Young's moduli from MD simulations, to be compared against hidden reference values from the paper.

steps.description: Compare reported Young's moduli to paper Table III values (15% relative tolerance, 5 GPa absolute floor) and check monotonic decreasing temperature trend for each model. Additionally, enforce CSV shape: only the three required columns, no extra columns, Model-1 rows before Model-2, and temperature strictly ascending per model. Format violations result in score 0.
